【原视频简介】
In this video I'll be trying to beat Terraria's newest update, 1.4.5.7 using melee weapons only. There has been major improvements to these weapons with some being completely reworked, changing their attacks entirely, along with a melee accessory added into the game so I'll be testing each one throughout the video to see how good these changes are and how progressing through the game feels like now. Without further ado, let's begin!
